Footer.tagline: AI-powered guidance for every farmer, in your own language.
Footer.disclaimer: AgriMitra AI gives general, decision-support guidance and is not a replacement for a qualified agricultural expert.

hero.title: Smarter farming decisions, in Telugu or English
hero.subtitle: Ask crop questions, check the weather, track mandi prices and spot crop issues from a photo — all in one simple app built for Indian farmers.

features.title: Everything a farmer needs, in one place
features.subtitle: Built for real farms, real questions and real weather.

chatbot.title: AI Chatbot
chatbot.description: Ask farming questions in plain Telugu or English and get clear, practical answers any time of day.

analysis.title: Crop Analysis
analysis.description: Upload a photo of a leaf or plant and get a possible-issue report with suggested next steps.

weather.title: Weather Intelligence
weather.description: Live forecasts for your exact village, with simple farming hints like when to avoid spraying.

market.title: Market Prices
market.description: Real mandi prices from data.gov.in for your state and district — no guesswork, no stale numbers.

voice.title: Telugu + Voice
voice.description: Speak your question in Telugu or English and hear the answer read back to you.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Get started in a few minutes.

step1.title: Create your account
step1.description: Sign up free with your email and set your village or town.

step2.title: Add your crops
step2.description: Tell AgriMitra AI what you're growing so advice fits your farm.

step3.title: Ask, check, upload
step3.description: Chat with the AI, check weather and prices, or upload a crop photo.

step4.title: Get clear guidance
step4.description: Receive simple, practical answers in your own language.

cta.title: Ready to farm smarter?
cta.subtitle: Join AgriMitra AI free and get guidance built for your crops and your location.
